title: Logarithmic-scale variational quantum eigensolver for off-lattice protein structure prediction in continuous torsional angle space
summary: Classical and current quantum approaches to protein structure prediction (QPSP) face limitations, notably massive qubit requirements restricting near-term models to simplistic on-lattice simulations. We propose a logarithmic-scale variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) that reduces qubit requirements for N torsional degrees of freedom to O(log2N), enabling off-lattice, all-atom simulations. Our architecture extracts molecular torsions from relative phases in statevector simulations.
